面的顶点不能共线: Face vertices cannot be collinear. Adjust their coordinates.
面的顶点必须共面: Face vertices must lie in the same plane. Adjust their coordinates.
面的顶点须沿边界顺序排列，不能自交: List face vertices in boundary order without self-intersections. Reorder the vertices.
面引用了不存在的顶点: A face references a missing vertex. Select its vertices again.
生成截面需要封闭凸多面体的面: A section requires the faces of a closed convex polyhedron. Add the missing faces.
截面需要封闭的多面体，每条边应连接两个面: A section requires a closed polyhedron with two faces meeting at each edge. Check the face vertices.
多面体不能退化为平面: The polyhedron cannot be flat. Adjust the vertex coordinates to form a solid.
当前截面支持凸多面体: Sections currently support convex polyhedra. Adjust the vertices and faces to make the solid convex.
截平面的法向量不能为零: The section plane normal cannot be zero. Set at least one of a, b, or c to a nonzero value.
截平面未切出有面积的截面: The plane does not produce a section with positive area. Adjust a, b, c, and d so it passes through the solid interior.
半径必须大于零: Radii must be greater than zero. Set both the horizontal and vertical radii to positive values.
文字超出画布，请缩小字号或精简标注: The text exceeds the canvas. Reduce its font size or shorten the label.
当前窗口内函数无有效值: The function has no valid values in the current window. Adjust its expression, domain, or canvas range.
